purpose: Transparent front anatomy plate for the personnel dossier interactive injury map. All labels, injury states and gameplay effects are rendered in Flutter.
prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: transparent anatomical illustration for the interactive injury status in a parchment-and-leather game personnel dossier.
Primary request: one exceptionally polished full-body neutral adult medical mannequin seen directly from the front, in the style of a vintage anatomical engraving. Create only the isolated figure, on a genuinely transparent background.
Subject: an anatomically proportionate, androgynous adult human medical study with smooth simplified face, no hair, no identity, nonsexual mannequin pelvis without external genitalia or nipples. The healthy neutral figure should be elegant and readable, neither muscular superhero nor emaciated skeleton. Fine bone landmarks visible through lightly shaded anatomy: skull contour, clavicles, restrained translucent ribcage, pelvis, long bones and knees. Include subtle symmetrical lungs in the ribcage as quiet anatomical landmarks, not coloured organs.
Composition: portrait canvas, perfectly centered upright full figure, straight-on orthographic front view, vertical body axis centered at 50 percent canvas width, crown near 5 percent height and soles near 95 percent. Arms relaxed about 15 degrees out from torso so each arm and hand is distinctly separated from the torso by transparent gaps; palms forward or neutral and fingers held together, natural hands. Legs straight with a small clear transparent gap between them, feet forward. Complete head, both hands, both feet visible. Figure occupies about 60 percent canvas width, with generous even transparent space around it.
Style and palette: refined nineteenth-century medical atlas copperplate / graphite engraving, extremely clean olive-sepia ink linework and delicate hatching, subtle translucent warm gray wash, restrained light and shade. Readable dark olive outline, muted internal detail. Preserve a calm dignified dossier feel. Detail must remain legible when displayed around 220px wide by 430px tall.
Constraints: ONE front-view figure only; no back view or side views; no background, parchment, page texture, frame, grid, labels, typography, numbers, arrows, legend, title, symbols, UI, logos or watermark. No injuries, scars, glowing points or red markings; these will be drawn interactively in code. No exposed viscera, gore, wounds, clothing, hair, dramatic lighting or sci-fi elements. Actual transparent alpha, not a checkerboard illustration.

runtime.encoding: scripts/runtime_images.py: WebP quality 90, exact lossless alpha, original dimensions

geometry.coordinate_system: Normalized x,y against the full 979 by 1607 image. Front view: character right appears at viewer left.

suggested_organ_callouts.note: Illustrative overlay anchors only; these coordinates do not supply game rules.

review.visual_review: Full head, hands and feet, calm olive/sepia engraving; readable ribs and limb landmarks, clear arm/torso and leg gaps, no gore or external genitalia.
review.limitation: An illustrative game UI plate; anatomy and landmark positions are approximate, not a medical reference.
